name: Oltárc (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Oltárc (a blue shield with a stag on a green mound, within a green wreath) below the words OLTÁRC KÖZSÉG ÖNKORMÁNYZATA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
